metric.equation: E(c,s,b) = max_{z in c_app} max(L - z, 0, z - U) / (U - L), where L = min(c_cal), U = max(c_cal)
metric.equivalent_closed_form: E = max(L - min(c_app), 0, max(c_app) - U) / (U - L) - only the calibration and application extrema are needed
metric.reads_as: how far beyond the calibration hull the application values reach, measured in units of the calibration range itself

threshold.interpretation: application values may extend no farther beyond the calibration hull than ONE FULL CALIBRATION RANGE
threshold.why_not_0: destructive - only 9 of 10,778 atoms retain full-domain support
threshold.why_not_2_or_more: progressively weaker interpretation; tau=1 is the unique grid value with a one-sentence reading and it sits inside a broad monotone stability region

degenerate_calibration.condition: U - L = 0 (the coordinate is constant on the calibration interval)
degenerate_calibration.otherwise: RANGE_SUPPORT_DEGENERATE_CALIBRATION - an explicit status, NOT a pass

coordinate_level_rule.predicate: RANGE_SUPPORT_PASS(c,s,b) iff E(c,s,b) <= tau and not degenerate
coordinate_level_rule.semantics: LOCAL to the (coordinate, calibration interval, application interval) triple

support_level_rule.predicate: RANGE_SUPPORT_PASS(C,s,b) iff EVERY coordinate c_j in C passes on that block
support_level_rule.auditable_quantity: max_j E(c_j,s,b), the support's worst-coordinate score

relationship_to_denominator_admissibilit.not_collapsed: denominator stability asks whether the coordinate map is DEFINED; range support asks whether the FITTED RELATION is empirically supported where it is applied
